name: mldr-trace-1
cmd: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p base && tar -xf baselines/base.tar -C base && (cp -R vendor/. base/vendor/ 2>/dev/null || true) && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && (cd base && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null) && grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; echo PAIR mine; (cd . && GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=3 /usr/bin/time -f 'PROCESS_SECONDS mine %e EXIT %x' timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only mldr --skip broken > out.json 2> err.log; echo VERDICT $(cut -c1-600 out.json); grep PROCESS_SECONDS err.log; grep 'counts: try' err.log | grep -i 'canVote/3\|disabled/0\|rows agree\|one primary\|canVote/1\|reconfigs/inS |' | cut -c1-230; grep 'counts: round\|counts: prof' err.log | cut -c1-300; grep -c 'counts: try' err.log) ; echo PAIR base; (cd base && GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=3 /usr/bin/time -f 'PROCESS_SECONDS base %e EXIT %x' timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only mldr --skip broken > out.json 2> err.log; echo VERDICT $(cut -c1-600 out.json); grep PROCESS_SECONDS err.log; grep 'counts: try' err.log | grep -i 'canVote/3\|disabled/0\|rows agree\|one primary\|canVote/1\|reconfigs/inS |' | cut -c1-230; grep 'counts: round\|counts: prof' err.log | cut -c1-300; grep -c 'counts: try' err.log)
